name: laravel-workers
description: Compile your Laravel app to a tiny JS bundle that runs on Cloudflare Workers. No PHP at the edge, no WASM, no cold-start drama — pure V8 isolates (p95 ≤ 5 ms CPU), D1, Blade → JS.
author: arfoux
